rationale: The closest architectural miss was first-pass anchored tail recurrence. I am transplanting that anchor back onto the current best, which now already protects recurrent-tail Q/K tensors in the final int8 path. This keeps parameter count and compile shape unchanged, preserves the current quant-aware/EMA endgame, and specifically tests whether giving each recurrent tail block its own first-pass anchor improves the final exact int8+zlib roundtrip score.
title: First-Pass Anchored Tail Recurrence On Recurrent-Tail QK Best
